'''Hunter Reeves''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{Zone|Critter Safari}}. They tell the player how to hunt a {{MobSprite|Scrappy}}.

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | First Interaction
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &eHunter Reeves&f: &fThat little ball nearby is actually a &9Scrappy&f all curled up.
&e[NPC] &eHunter Reeves&f: &fMy &cCritter Capsules&f are useless against it in this state...
&e[NPC] &eHunter Reeves&f: &fHowever, that &6"Hunter" Tobias&f guy told me that you can sometimes coax them into coming out with &eFood&f.
&e[NPC] &eHunter Reeves&f: &fHe said that each &9Scrappy&f is different, and they like either &6Wholesale Wheat&f, &bFlavor-packed Fish&f, or &6Lush Lily Pads&f.
}}
|-
| class="ct" | After Catching
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &eHunter Reeves&f: &fYou really managed to catch that &9Scrappy&f? Nice going!
&e[NPC] &eHunter Reeves&f: &fKeep an eye out for my brothers - they might have found more &9Scrappy&f around...
}}
|}

== Trivia ==
* '''Hunter Reeves''' is the brother of {{NPCSprite|Hunter Jasper}} and {{NPCSprite|Hunter Luigi}}.
